name: Chaitanya Maili
title: Engineering Manager | Cloud Native | Platform Engineering | Team Leadership
aboutMe:
15 years building distributed systems at scale. For the last several years I have been functioning as the engineering manager of record for Pantheon's cloud-native infrastructure initiatives — owning architecture decisions, delivery sequencing, cross-team coordination, and the career growth of the engineers doing the work.

At Pantheon I set the architecture for a multi-year filesystem migration, coordinate across teams, manage the engineers doing the work, and represent the project to engineering leadership. Weekly 1:1s, performance conversations, design reviews, and incremental ownership transfer are the core of how I run the team.

At Mindtree I managed a 10-member team across concurrent enterprise projects. I ran sprints, conducted performance reviews, participated in hiring, drove quality improvements that cut production bugs by 40%, and owned client relationships end to end.

Cloud-native platform infrastructure is where my technical depth and people leadership intersect. That is the environment where I do my best work as an engineering manager.

workExperience.title: Staff Engineer · Technical Lead & People Manager
description: Engineering manager in function for Pantheon's cloud-native filesystem migration — owned architecture decisions, quarterly roadmap sequencing, cross-team dependency management, and delivery accountability to engineering leadership. On track to reduce operational overhead by 30%.

Managed 3 engineers through the full complexity of the project: weekly 1:1s, performance conversations, design reviews, and deliberate ownership transfer. 2 engineers have since taken on independently scoped lead work; one is now functioning as a tech lead.
Partnered with engineering leadership on headcount planning, roadmap sequencing, and cross-team technical alignment. Represented team architecture and delivery status in leadership reviews.
Contributed hands-on in Go and Terraform — backend microservices and infrastructure-as-code focused on observability, reliability, and reducing operational surface area for on-call engineers.

workExperience.title: Engineering Manager / Technical Architect
description: Managed a 10-member development team across concurrent enterprise Drupal 8/9 engagements — accountable for technical direction, sprint planning, code quality, hiring decisions, and delivery against client commitments.
Conducted regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations with direct reports. Participated in hiring loops and ran structured onboarding for new engineers.
Introduced visual regression testing in CI and static analysis via PHPMD — reduced production UI bugs by 40% post-deployment. A team-level culture change, not just a tooling addition.
Owned full-lifecycle migration of a major enterprise site from CoreMedia to Drupal — scoping through launch, coordinating with client stakeholders throughout to minimise disruption.

Responsible for system reliability: designed and maintained critical cron jobs and third-party API integrations with a focus on fault tolerance.

Built REST APIs in CakePHP powering pricing logic, quote versioning, and S3-based artifact storage. Took on DevOps responsibility for the pricing infrastructure alongside feature work.
